items.title: Bags & Buckets Fundraiser
items.description: Join the Heartland Enforcers for a community fundraiser featuring blind-draw cornhole, youth basketball activities, and a silent auction. Registration begins at 10:00 AM and bags fly at 11:00 AM. Cornhole entry is $25 per player. Registration takes place outside this app preview.

items.title: Gus Macker — Quincy 2027
items.description: The dates for Gus Macker in Quincy are set for May 29–30, 2027. H.A.G. continues event planning and partnerships. Venue details will be shared only after confirmation.
